narr: A short wave and a weak cold front moved into the region allowing scattered showers and storms to develop. Heavy rain moved across Iberia Parish which caused isolated flash flooding.
ev: Local media reported significant street flooding in New Iberia. Some roadways were briefly closed with water half way up vehicles.
lsr: LOCAL MEDIA POSTED VIDEO ON FACEBOOK OF SIGNIFICANT WATER ACROSS THE ROADS IN NEW IBERIA. WATER HALF WAY UP VEHICLES.
